contest.name: ARRL Field Day
contest.description: ARRL Field Day — the fourth full weekend of June, an emergency-preparedness operating exercise. Work as many stations as possible on 160-10m HF (no WARC bands) and all bands 50 MHz and above. Exchange is operating class + ARRL/RAC section (e.g. '3A CT'); DX stations send class + 'DX'. Phone QSO = 1 point, CW and Digital QSO = 2 points. Final score is QSO points x the power multiplier (x5 for 5 W or less on natural power, x2 for 100 W or less, x1 for more than 100 W) plus bonus points. The Rule 7.3 bonus points (emergency power, media publicity, GOTA, satellite QSO, W1AW bulletin, youth participation, etc.) are proof-based claims submitted on the official ARRL Field Day entry and are NOT auto-computed here — ContestLogX scores the QSO-points x power-multiplier portion. A GOTA station operates under its own callsign and is logged separately; satellite QSOs are logged as normal QSOs.
contest.startDate: Fourth full weekend of June (2026: June 27-28, 1800Z Sat to 2059Z Sun)

userPrompts.question: Enter your Field Day class: number of transmitters + class letter (e.g., 3A, 1D, 2F, 1B).
userPrompts.description: Operating class sent in the exchange. Letter: A (club/group portable), B (1-2 person portable), C (mobile), D (home), E (home, emergency power), F (EOC). A-Battery/B-Battery send A/B.

userPrompts.question: Enter your ARRL/RAC section (e.g., CT, EMA, ONS) or DX if outside the ARRL/RAC field organization.
userPrompts.description: ARRL/RAC section sent in the exchange; DX stations send DX.

userPrompts.question: Select your power level (determines the Field Day power multiplier).

options.label: 5 W or less, natural power (battery / solar / wind / water — not mains or generator) — power multiplier x5
100 W or less (or 5 W or less from mains / generator) — power multiplier x2
More than 100 W — power multiplier x1

userPrompts.description: Per Rule 7.2 the multiplier is set by the highest output power used by any transmitter during the event. Classes A/B/C are capped at 500 W PEP; D/E/F at 100 W PEP.

sent.name: SECTs
sent.description: ARRL/RAC section sent (e.g., CT), or DX

received.name: SECTr
received.description: ARRL/RAC section received (e.g., EMA), or DX

scoring.description: Field Day has no QSO multipliers. Score = QSO points x power multiplier. Rule 7.3 bonus points are claimed on the ARRL summary sheet and added there; they are not computed by ContestLogX.

dupeChecking.description: A station may be worked once per band per mode — Phone, CW, and Digital count separately, so the same station is workable up to three times on a band (Rule 6.3). All voice modes (SSB/FM/AM) count as one Phone mode; all non-CW digital modes count as one Digital mode.

callHistory.description: Save received class and section for future lookups

cabrillo.notes: Cabrillo is accepted in lieu of a dupe sheet but does not by itself constitute an entry — the ARRL summary sheet / web app is required. HF frequencies in kHz; VHF and above logged by band.

exchangeValidation.description: Class and section are collected but not validated against a fixed list — the operator is responsible for correct entry. Section may be any ARRL/RAC section or DX.
